attributes.title: 2027 NJVMA Veterinary Education Conference
attributes.summary:
The New Jersey VMA holds its 2027 Veterinary Education Conference on May 15 and 16, 2027, at Harrah's in Atlantic City. The association describes the VEC as its main CE event for New Jersey veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and veterinary students.

NJVMA presents the meeting as a way to collect CE needed for license renewal, including opioid-related sessions, with tracks such as pain management and emergency and critical care.

Fees, the number of CE hours and the session list are not published yet; only the save-the-date is online.
